gaps: No compressive, flexural, flow, viscosity or air values are given in the review notes; results are not transcribed.
The source labels the ledger per 1 m³ although it totals 247.06 kg; the amounts are entered as kg per batch with that conflict noted.
The combined activator is not split into NaOH and silicate masses, and the 1:2.5 ratio basis is unresolved.
The shared ledger (with admixture 1.06 kg) is attached to all four variants; no admixture-free reference is labelled in the notes.
Commercial SP identity/solids, moisture corrections and post-heating storage are unresolved.
